prompt:
Use the provided reference images as the main visual references. Create a highly photorealistic full-body fashion portrait of the same beautiful young Korean woman with delicate facial features, expressive dark eyes, naturally shaped eyebrows, soft rosy lips, smooth realistic skin texture, and a bright, natural smile.

Her dark brown hair is neatly parted in the center and styled into a refined low bun, with soft face-framing strands falling naturally around her cheeks. Keep the hairstyle elegant and feminine.

She wears a light pastel-yellow long-sleeve button-up blouse with the sleeves casually rolled to the forearms, paired with a flowing high-waisted white midi/maxi skirt decorated with small scattered black and dark-gray flying-bird prints. Add a delicate silver chain necklace, subtle earrings, and elegant black ankle-strap high heels.

Create a sophisticated, graceful pose: she is seated elegantly on a modern light stone bench, one leg slightly extended and the other naturally positioned, with one hand resting gently near her chin and the other relaxed across her lap. In another variation, show her standing naturally with both hands softly crossed in front of her waist.

Set the scene inside a bright luxury minimalist home with large floor-to-ceiling windows, warm cream and beige architecture, soft natural daylight, a large green indoor palm/plant, subtle modern furniture, and an airy premium atmosphere.

Photography style: ultra-photorealistic Korean fashion editorial, realistic skin pores, detailed hair strands, accurate hands and fingers, realistic fabric folds, natural body proportions, soft diffused daylight, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, creamy background bokeh, high dynamic range, elegant warm-neutral tones, premium lifestyle photography, crisp focus, 8K detail.

Preserve the exact overall outfit concept from the references: pastel-yellow blouse, white bird-print skirt, elegant heels, refined hairstyle, and sophisticated feminine styling. No cartoon effect, no plastic skin, no excessive makeup, no distorted face, no extra fingers, no deformed hands, no warped clothing.

promptZh:
请使用提供的参考图作为主要视觉参考。创作一张高度写实的全身时尚人像，主角为同一位美丽的年轻 韩国女性，她拥有精致的五官、富有表现力的深色双眸、自然修饰的眉毛、柔和的玫瑰色双唇、细腻真实的皮肤质感，以及明亮自然的微笑。

她深棕色的头发中分，梳成精致的低发髻，几缕柔和的发丝自然地垂落在脸颊两侧。保持发型优雅且充满女性魅力。

她身穿一件 浅淡黄色长袖衬衫，袖口随意卷至前臂，搭配一条 飘逸的高腰白色中长/长裙，裙身点缀着零星的黑色和深灰色飞鸟印花。佩戴精致的银色项链、简约的耳环，以及优雅的黑色踝带高跟鞋。

打造一个精致优雅的姿势：她优雅地坐在现代浅色石质长凳上，一条腿微微伸展，另一条腿自然放置，一只手轻托下巴，另一只手自然地放在膝盖上。在另一个变体中，展示她自然站立，双手轻叠于腰前的姿态。

场景设定在明亮的奢华极简风住宅内，配有落地大窗、奶油色和米色调的建筑结构、柔和的自然日光、大型绿色室内棕榈植物、简约的现代家具，营造出通透的高级氛围。

摄影风格：超写实韩系时尚杂志大片，真实的皮肤毛孔，细腻的发丝，精准的手部和手指，真实的织物褶皱，自然的人体比例，柔和的漫射日光，50mm 镜头，浅景深，奶油般虚化的背景，高动态范围，优雅的暖中性色调，高端生活方式摄影，清晰对焦，8K 细节。

保留参考图中整体服装的概念：淡黄色衬衫、白色鸟纹裙、优雅高跟鞋、精致发型以及高级的女性化造型。拒绝卡通效果，拒绝塑料感皮肤，拒绝浓妆艳抹，拒绝面部扭曲，拒绝多余手指，拒绝手部畸形，拒绝衣物变形。
